info.about: Klonoa 2: Dream Champ Tournament is a video game published by Namco and released on the Game Boy Advance in Japan in 2002 and North America in early 2005.
info.trivia: Developed by Now Production, it came out in Japan in August 2002 but did not reach North America until February 2005.
info.why: Namco released it in the US three months after the Nintendo DS launched and two and a half years after Japan, so it had little time on GBA shelves.
